name: Retry Storm
description: High-contention writes on hot rows forcing serialization conflicts (SQLSTATE 40001)

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_accounts (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, name STRING NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
seed_sql: UPSERT INTO bench_accounts (id, name, balance) VALUES ($1, $2, 1000.0)

operations.name: contended_update
sql: SELECT balance FROM bench_accounts WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE bench_accounts SET balance = $1 WHERE id = $2
